column1: # The compiler and the flags of each source file (docs/TOOLCHAIN.md).
# `compiler` names the folder under the toolchain's lib/gcc-lib/ee/ whose cc1plus
# builds the game. Flags are one row per file, never per function; `default`
# applies to every file without a row of its own. A file's row may name its own
# compiler in a third column: Sony's libraries were built with Sony's
# 2.9-ee-991111, as OpenRAC builds its SDK objects, and the math library with its
# Linux build 2.9-ee-991111-01, as OpenRAC's rac1-decomp builds those objects
